aiBuilder.title: AI Profile Interview
aiBuilder.intro: Add your API settings, then chat naturally. AI will ask follow-up questions and generate cards automatically.
aiBuilder.debugHint: Inspect each request, model output, tool call, and parsed generation result.
aiBuilder.noDebugYet: No debug logs yet. Send a message first.
aiBuilder.quickReply1: Let me start with nickname and MBTI
aiBuilder.quickReply2: Start from the games I play most
aiBuilder.quickReply3: I want to highlight my oshis
aiBuilder.quickReply4: You ask the questions, let's go step by step.
aiBuilder.apiKeyRequired: Please configure your API Key in the settings (top right)
aiBuilder.welcomeQuestion: Hi! I can build your profile card. What name should I use, and what vibe do you want?
aiBuilder.fallbackQuestion: Great. One more thing: what games or fandoms do you spend the most time on lately?
aiBuilder.inputPlaceholder: Example: I'm Mikan, INFP, I play Genshin and HSR, and I stan Hatsune Miku...
aiBuilder.forceGeneratePrompt: That should be enough. Please generate my profile card now.
aiBuilder.applySuccess: Done. I applied the generated cards to your editor.
aiBuilder.emptyCardsError: AI did not return usable cards. Add a bit more info and try again.
aiBuilder.unknownError: Generation failed. Please check network, API key, or model name.
aiBuilder.NETWORK_ERROR: Network request failed. Check your connection; for a custom endpoint, also make sure it allows browser requests (CORS).
aiBuilder.PARSE_ERROR: Server returned an unparseable response (non-JSON). Check your Base URL.
aiBuilder.EMPTY_RESPONSE: AI returned an empty response. Please retry.
aiBuilder.MALFORMED_CALL: AI function call format error. Please retry or switch models.
aiBuilder.TIMEOUT: The AI took too long to respond, so the request was cancelled. Try again later or pick a faster model.
aiBuilder.TRUNCATED: The AI response was too long and got cut off. Click “Generate Now” to retry, or share a bit less.
aiBuilder.keyPrivacy: Your key stays in this browser. Requests go straight to the selected provider, never through this site.
aiBuilder.onboardStep2: Sign in with Google, click “Create API key”, then paste it below
aiBuilder.onboardPrivacy: Your key stays in this browser and requests go straight to Google, never through this site. On the free tier Google may use conversations to improve its products, so don’t share your real name, phone number or other private details.
